title: Residual Shock
summary: Residual Shock is an Arcane Enhancement for Kitguns that grants them the ability to create spikes of  Electricity on kill.
extract:
Residual Shock is an Arcane Enhancement for Kitguns that grants them the ability to create spikes of  Electricity on kill.
Can be sold for  ‍1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Residual Shock can be acquired from Rotation A of Isolation Vault Bounties (normal and Arcana).

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Electrified spikes have a 20% chance to proc  Electricity status.
Residual Arcanes can only have two active puddles at a time. For example; creating two puddles with a primary kitgun will prevent both your primary and secondary kitgun from creating any until the first two expire.
Will deal electric zaps that do not add or combine with weapon elemental effects, retaining the electric damage on zaps.

Trivia
The Orokin Writing on the Residual Shock's image directly translates to "Shock".
